goal: Write a cover letter for a UX researcher role at a health-tech startup, showing how 8 years as an ICU nurse prepared me
audience: a hiring manager who skims for evidence of research skills
role: an experienced career coach who has hired UX researchers

inputs.label: My resume (summary)
inputs.content: ICU nurse, 8 years, St. Mary's Hospital. Led a 6-month study of alarm fatigue: 40 nurse interviews, shadowing, redesigned alarm triage cards adopted unit-wide. Google UX Design Certificate (2025). Portfolio: 3 case studies.

context: The company builds remote patient monitoring software
I am applying cold, with no referral

constraints.text: Do not use the phrases 'passionate about' or 'team player'
Mention one concrete result with a number

structure: Close with a call to action

success_criteria: A skimming reader finds a research method and a result in the first two paragraphs
